summary.title: Executive Summary
summary.text: Senior executive with 30+ years of P&L accountability (up to CZK 1B revenue) and a track record of complex transformations in finance, IT, and operations. Repeatedly deployed as de-facto COO/CFO to stabilize, integrate, or carve out business units.
summary.highlight1: Direct board reporting: 19 years in board and executive director roles (Aramark, Altron, Lagardere).
summary.highlight2: Managing budgets and cross-functional teams of 100+ FTE in matrix organizations.
summary.highlight3: Delivered CZK 40M in savings (process & IT optimization, re-tendering key suppliers), freed CZK 50M in working capital, reduced closing cycle by 30% through ERP projects.
summary.highlight4: Certified PRINCE2, US-GAAP, IFRS; fluent in Czech and English, experienced with global auditors (EY, KPMG).
